examples.en: All right, I'll reword my question.
examples.zh: 好吧，我换个说法来问这个问题。

examples.en: Reword that slightly, and you have the battle cry of half the men I dated.
examples.zh: 稍稍重组一下词汇，我约会过的男人中起码有一半会为他“助阵呐喊“。

examples.en: This way you get an idea of what they are reading and you can reword it if needed.
examples.zh: 这样你得到一个他们所读的想法，你可以改写，如果需要的。
